content: Recommended idle-timeout ranges: 2-5 min for high-value/sensitive apps, up to 15-30 min for low-risk; NIST/CIS/PCI-DSS commonly converge around a 15-minute ceiling. Distinguish 'lock' (re-authenticate but session/derived key can remain suspended in memory) from 'logout' (full session/key destruction) -- for a vault holding decryption keys, lock should actively wipe the in-memory derived key, not just hide the UI, or the key remains recoverable via memory inspection while 'locked'.
